item.title: Hegseth to cut number of US general and admiral positions by 20%
item.description: Pentagon official says the plan will be announced in the defence secretary's 'State of the Force' address in Virginia.

item.title: Israel’s Lapid accuses Netanyahu of ‘fear-mongering’ over attack warning
item.description: Opposition leader dismisses Netanyahu's warning of possible attacks during next month's general election.

item.title: South African president orders action on femicide after killings
item.description: South Africa’s President Cyril Ramaphosa has announced new measures to combat femicide and gender-based violence.

item.title: Democrats hope anger at Trump enough to get young people to vote
item.description: Political strategist Celinda Lake says that young voters don’t usually cast their ballots in midterm elections.

item.title: String of rapes in Delhi triggers social campaign for women’s safety
item.description: Women in India’s capital are protesting after a string of rape cases, using bold slogans to demand safer public spaces.

item.title: Public workers in France strike over pay as student protests turn violent
item.description: Tens of thousands of workers march nationwide, as police arrest 440 students in clashes at schools.

item.title: Trump backs AI self-regulation at tech summit but is it enough?
item.description: US President Donald Trump and leading tech companies have signed a voluntary agreement to regulate AI development.

item.title: Somali pirates killed five crew members on hijacked tanker, officials say
item.description: The deaths appear to be the first at the hands of Somali pirates in more than a decade.

item.title: US Senate blocks resolution seeking report on Americans killed in West Bank
item.description: The resolution cites a 'lack of accountability' by Israel's government and an 'inability to secure justice' by the US.

item.title: Protesters block Orange Order march in Northern Ireland
item.description: Protesters block Orange Order route into Catholic area of Portadown after court allows march for first time in 28 years.

item.title: King appoints Morocco’s first female prime minister
item.description: Morocco’s King Mohammed VI has named Marrakesh’s long-time mayor as the country’s first female prime minister.

item.title: Morocco’s pro-Palestine protests challenge Rabat’s deepening Israel ties
item.description: Protests across Morocco highlight gap between public opposition to normalisation and Rabat’s closer ties with Israel.

item.title: Indonesia suspends five officials over luxury apartments for inmates
item.description: Warden among five officials suspended over the discovery of an apartment-style compound for inmates at Cibinong prison.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump claims war will end ‘very soon’, gives no details
item.description: US President Donald Trump reiterates that Tehran will not have a nuclear weapon.

item.title: Trump says he plans to campaign for 32 days before midterm elections
item.description: US president brushes aside concerns about his popularity as voters express frustration over cost of living, war on Iran.

item.title: ‘Nothing is justifying this’: Qatar’s PM slams Israel’s atrocities in Gaza
item.description: Qatar's top diplomat says Israel has undermined Doha's efforts to broker a ceasefire in Gaza from 'day one'.

item.title: Trump, tech bosses sign voluntary pact pledging ‘robust’ AI safeguards
item.description: US President Trump touts self-regulation amid the international community's and industry's calls for formal rules.

item.title: Jack Smith defends investigations into Trump during tense US Senate hearing
item.description: Former US special counsel rejects claims that his probes improperly targeted Republicans and conservative groups.

item.title: Venezuelan man shot by ICE officer in Texas is charged with assault
item.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez has disputed the government's account of what led to his shooting during a DoorDash delivery.

item.title: Iraq begins high-stakes security balancing act as US troops withdraw
item.description: Iraq marks national 'Sovereignty Days' as US troops depart, but must navigate risks of new security landscape.

item.title: Man City CEO: Premier League verdict based on ‘conspiracy theory’
item.description: Man City says it will appeal after an independent commission convicted it of breaking Premier League financial rules.

item.title: UN extends mandate of Gang Suppression Force in Haiti for six months
item.description: Security force members deployed to Haiti have struggled to make progress against criminal groups as violence continues.

item.title: US consumer confidence hits its lowest level since 2014 ahead of midterms
item.description: Rising goods and fuel costs are cited as key factors in the sharp drop in consumer confidence.

item.title: US Supreme Court allows Trump to continue third-country deportations
item.description: The high court grants an emergency petition ahead of expected arguments in the case, slated for December.

item.title: Yamal stars as Spain thrash Croatia
item.description: Lamine Yamal scores twice and assists another as Spain beat Croatia 4-1 in UEFA Nations League Group A3
